comparison.objective: Tie and tension an overhand knot in a free cord.

comparison.success_condition: Released knot remains intact five seconds, plus a 117 cm suspended-span check for full credit.
comparison.reason: Tests deformable topology and tensioning, not coaxial mandrel placement, notch fracture, retained-insert protection or tang containment.
